title: Hamamelis virginiana tincture for medicinal use
intro: Hamamelis virginiana tincture is a preparation made from the bark and leaves of the witch hazel plant, which is native to North America. It is commonly used in herbalism for its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and soothing properties. The tincture is often applied topically to treat skin irritations, wounds, and hemorrhoids due to its ability to reduce swelling and promote healing. It may also be used internally in small doses to support digestive health and manage mild bleeding. In traditional herbal medicine, it is valued for its versatility and gentle yet effective action on both the skin and internal systems.
